detail: Cornerstone's 2027 roster address sends you to the 2026 roster, which has 30 players.

34 entries posted: 28 WHAC games (all doubleheaders), 4 games at Webber International Feb 26-27, the RussMatt Central Florida Invitational Mar 2-12 and the WHAC Tournament May 6-8 in Howell. The Webber games have no times yet.
The coaches page lists Lowitzki, Sackett and Cusick, the same three as the 2026 roster page.
Prep Baseball Report's Michigan commitments list shows 3 from the class of 2026: Deister, Harless and Janigian.
